::: {#def-bootstrap-sample}
#### Bootstrap sample

A **bootstrap sample** from observed data $x_1, \ldots, x_n$
is a sample of size $n$ drawn **with replacement**
from $\cb{x_1, \ldots, x_n}$,
each draw choosing each of the $n$ observations
with probability $1/n$.
:::

::: notes
Because the draws are with replacement,
a bootstrap sample usually contains some observations more than once
and omits others.
:::
